mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users (username, password_hash, nickname, phone, role, enabled, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{username}, #{passwordHash}, #{nickname}, #{phone}, #{role}, #{enabled}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE users SET role = #{role}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE users SET enabled = #{enabled}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE users SET password_hash = #{passwordHash}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users WHERE role = #{role}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users WHERE role = 'ADMIN' AND enabled = 1
mapper.sql:
WHERE role IN ('OPERATOR', 'ADMIN')
AND (username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR nickname LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
mapper.select:
SELECT id, username, password_hash, nickname, phone, role, enabled, created_at, updated_at FROM users
ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}
